# src/components/wizard/steps

Compiled from `contracts/rules`. Change a rule there (`npm run learn -- ...`), never here.

- **invariant** `wizard/ask-graphic-type-question-dropdown-carrying`: Ask the graphic-TYPE question with ONE dropdown carrying BOTH levels: the shelves as SELECTABLE heading rows over `browsableGroups`, their member categories NBSP-indented under them, each row with its live count. Use no `<optgroup>` and no "All <shelf>" row - the heading itself is the whole-shelf answer. Option values are `group:<id>` or `cat:<id>`, and a category answer ALWAYS sets its shelf too.
- **invariant** `wizard/build-whole-kit-moment-kit-step`: Build the whole kit the moment the Kit step's Next is taken and land on the kit's Finish step as its HUB, where every graphic opens for editing in any order. `KitPlan` keeps one draft per graphic so leaving one and coming back is lossless, the tray's chips are navigation that open another graphic on the same step, there is no look question, and both hub doors SAVE FIRST with every write claimed.
- **invariant** `wizard/keep-finish-wizard-branch-carrying-graphic`: Keep Finish the wizard ONE branch, carrying the graphic name from `draft.name` applied inside `buildDraftTemplate` so it reaches the topbar, the Save prefill and the export slug through one path. Blank falls back to the design catalog name. That name slugs the zip and, for the SPX and CasparCG targets, the template FOLDER inside it.
- **invariant** `wizard/order-entry-step-four-equal-start`: Order the Entry step's four equal start cards as the product reads - Start from a template, Import graphics, Create with AI, then the greyed Video card - in one row with no card tinted as primary, and the Playout row under them. Keep its deliberate divergences: no kit card, no Blank card, and cards act on CLICK rather than radio-plus-Continue. Create with AI is the ONE AI door: NoaCG Pro is an execution TIER inside it, never a second card. `e2e/wizard-entry-fit.spec.ts` pins the layout.
- **invariant** `wizard/put-door-each-kit-community-packs`: Put ONE door each for the kit and the Community packs shelf at the top of Browse, where `.wz-buildmode` swaps the body between the design grid, KitPicker and CommunityPacks; a kit row is a card with a settled MiniPreview, its name and type, still carrying `data-kit-item`. On the shelf a visitor's one card action is Install, its giving half (Submit a pack, Your packs, an admin's review) sits beside the cards, and Next, Skip to finish, the brand chooser and the format controls stand down.
- **invariant** `wizard/set-aside-word-nothing-catalog-carries`: Set aside a word nothing in the catalog carries and SAY IT BACK: `browseTemplates` returns `ignored` and the count line renders it. A query made only of unreachable words still honestly returns nothing.
- **trap** `wizard/gate-every-kit-preview-intersection-give`: Gate every kit preview on intersection, and give `.wz-kit-thumb` `pointer-events: none` so clicking the picture of the graphic you want toggles it.
- **trap** `wizard/pay-any-growth-entry-step-out`: Pay for any growth on the Entry step out of another part: at 1366x768 its height is a fixed budget holding the hero, one row of four start cards and the Playout row under them.
- **rule** `wizard/caption-browse-card-name-alone-say`: Caption a Browse card with the NAME alone and say what the graphic IS on the line under it. The style family is a FILTER, not an identity: it rides the last line beside complexity as a dim `.wz-style-tag`, never opposite the name and never in a per-family colour. The style row wears a `.wz-filter-lead` caption naming the question it answers.
- **rule** `wizard/carry-caveat-entry-start-card-create`: Carry no caveat on an Entry start card: Create with AI has no Beta tag and no testing note, and the Video card is greyed with no not-recommended sentence, the grey being its whole signal. Neither door is ever disabled: a visitor known to be signed out gets the sign-in dialog when pressing Video, and a session still resolving is treated as signed in.
- **rule** `wizard/drive-fields-step-variant-declared-capabilities`: Drive the Fields step from the variant declared CAPABILITIES: up to `maxLines` text lines, plus the logo toggle and custom upload on a `logo: optional` design. A legacy built-in slot shows checked and locked rather than offering a choice that does nothing.
- **rule** `wizard/feed-footer-brand-chooser-browse-context`: Feed the footer brand chooser into Browse as `brandFamily` CONTEXT, never a filter: the package siblings rank first, no chip appears, Clear-all leaves it alone, and a genuine programme match always outranks it. It re-ranks without resetting the page, because the reader asked for those extra results and a re-rank should not take them away.
- **rule** `wizard/hold-browse-cards-strict-info-budget`: Hold Browse cards to a strict info budget - category and subtype, top families, field summary from semantics, at most three capability badges, complexity, style family - and put everything the budget excludes one info click away in the card detail panel. That button is a SIBLING of the card button, never nested, and one panel is open at a time.
- **rule** `wizard/name-template-dishonestly-zero-results-offer`: Name no template dishonestly on zero results: offer to remove the most limiting filter - computed as the chip whose removal restores the most results - and hand off to Create with AI.
- **rule** `wizard/offer-only-palette-roles-design-actually`: Offer only the palette roles `cssPaintsWith` says the design paints with, and let the same question decide its TYPEFACE roles (`FONT_ROLES`), whose overrides are keyed by the BARE variable name like every other one on the step. The Style step carries two size knobs, graphic size and text size.
- **rule** `wizard/open-entry-hero-landing-page-headline`: Open the entry hero with the landing page headline verbatim and an intro naming the three ways to make graphics, then EVERY route to air - the browser source, NoaCG Playout through NoaCG Bridge, and every export target, never a sample of three. Carry no second brand mark and no export-target chip row: a new export target updates this copy.
- **rule** `wizard/put-format-picker-search-above-kit`: Put the format picker and the SEARCH above the kit branch as one box - designs on one side, shows and the graphics a kit can hold on the other - with the facets standing down. Filtering hides rows and never unticks them, and the count stays the whole SELECTION.
- **rule** `wizard/show-chip-whole-type-answer-naming`: Show ONE chip for the whole type answer, naming the narrowest level and clearing both levels. Carry no member-category chip row.
- **rule** `wizard/show-page-browse-results-catalog-twelve`: Show a PAGE of Browse results, not the catalog: twelve plus a "Show 12 more", with both numbers stated in the count line. Keep `browseTemplates` returning the WHOLE result with no limit argument, spend the limit on the RANKING and then split it into the two sections, and derive the page reset during render off a signature rather than in an effect. In specs, search for a named design and assert `resultTotal`, never a card count.
- **rule** `wizard/show-run-show-every-entry-visit`: Show Run the show on every Entry visit as a pressable card on the Home row chassis: its body opens the production saved most recently and names it, or opens the productions list and says so when there is none, and New production is a SIBLING button that creates an empty production and opens its rundown. Show the Home row full width only when there is saved work, with the Graphics and Productions shortcuts as SIBLINGS of the body button.
- **rule** `wizard/take-video-mode-straight-instant-create`: Take video mode straight to an INSTANT create - prompt, generation-engine picker, duration, aspect, fps, transparency and asset upload - seeding the brief as the first chat turn and recording the engine on the project. Generation runs in the video shell chat, not the wizard. Creating or opening a video flips the document kind, and every catalog create path flips it back.
- **rule** `wizard/write-speed-buttons-follow-template-own`: Write 0.6, 1 and 1.8 from the speed buttons, and follow the TEMPLATE own durations for the lifecycle demo stop and replay rather than a fixed pair. Have the easing dropdown react to the motion and show the plain names, dropping a choice to Auto when the picked motion cannot render the current curve.
